answer: Proof of Work provides robust Sybil resistance for AI agents by requiring computational expenditure to participate in the network. Like a jetty stabilizing a harbor against chaotic tides, this mechanism forces an attacker to expend energy for every identity, preventing the echo of a single entity masquerading as a multitude. The cost is analogous to shifting a dune of sand grain by grain; an adversary must possess sufficient hardware and power to validate their influence, ensuring that consensus remains tied to physical resources.
